claim: Minimization and maximization gaps admit pointwise and infimum/supremum ceilings, with strict/weak threshold distinction.
assumptions: Feasible incumbent, objective uniformly bounded on the nonempty domain for the infimum/supremum assertion.
falsifier: Empty or unbounded domain; equality at target allowed.

claim: Nonattainment of the floor permits strict exclusion even where the ceiling equals the target.
assumptions: A separate proof excludes attainment by every admissible candidate.
falsifier: A feasible candidate at the floor invalidates the additional premise.

claim: Finite weighted opportunity bounds admit missing-case fallback floors at original weights.
assumptions: Nonnegative weights, all cases covered, common objective and admissible candidate. Total weight one for mean units.
falsifier: Missing mass, wrong denominator or negative weight.

claim: Relaxed/physical/observation-compatible/deadline-constrained infima are ordered; finer observations can be ignored.
assumptions: Common horizon, cost, nonempty nested sets, bounded values, baseline allowed.
falsifier: A deadline or information mismatch invalidates nesting.

claim: A cost floor excludes positive net value if gross ceiling is no greater; discounts preserve pointwise bounds.
assumptions: Correct unit/horizon tags, justified floor, nonnegative weights, proper pathwise accounting.
falsifier: Mislabelled inputs, mixing dollars and energy or cross-horizon costs.

claim: Boxed and mixed-row LP multipliers give exact lower certificates for feasible points.
assumptions: True row/variable activity intervals, exact signed multipliers and matrix products for the same representation.
falsifier: Positive multiplier on upper-only row; unsupported one-sided residual sign.

claim: Upper feasible gain and bounded transfer/enclosure require admissible candidates and explicit model maps or allowances.
assumptions: Actual model-domain membership and one-sided objective domination.
falsifier: A primal residual alone cannot prove feasibility.

claim: Conditional cost comparison preserves the imposed service, risk and stock contract. Uniform per-scenario loss bounds transfer to any monotone cash-shifting risk measure.
assumptions: All applicable dimensions constrained and pointwise losses bounded; risk assumptions verified for the selected functional.
falsifier: Mean gain alone fails a two-point CVaR counterexample.

claim: Nonpositive expected penalties for every common policy turn augmented path floors into an aggregate lower bound.
assumptions: Nonnegative weights and a policy-wide centering inequality with respect to the same information/measure.
falsifier: A positive expected penalty can fabricate a false floor.

claim: A two-state common-action problem has perfect-foresight gap 1/2 and centered bound gap zero.
assumptions: Illustrative model with one shared action and two equiprobable indistinguishable states.
falsifier: Scenario-specific admissible actions would change the operational contract.

claim: A continuous constant inventory credit telescopes and a uniform feasible closing repair of cost K caps the difference of the terminal-contract infima.
assumptions: Identical opening positions for the accounting comparison, uniform cross-contract repair for the full operational premium.
falsifier: A narrow SOC box alone supplies no bound in dollars.

claim: The pinned build inspected 49 declarations, kernel-replayed four theorem modules and rejected eight designated invalid statements or type mismatches.
assumptions: Pinned Lean and mathlib with prebuilt imports; same kernel as compiler.
falsifier: Mismatch on clean replay or undeclared axiom.

claim: Exact finite controls passed for 2250 LP witnesses, 12 domain-sign configurations and 1071 common-action and distribution pairs.
assumptions: Specified rational grids and constructed instances; synthetic finite tests.
falsifier: A reproduced bound above its feasible tested cost.

claim: Under the flat W05 tariff and fixed hourly service, affine stock and cumulative discharge coefficients plus a valid ramp envelope bound economic gain.
assumptions: True stationary prices/efficiencies, fixed service, valid physical envelope and nonnegative relevant coefficients.
falsifier: Excessive credit, negative prices, a changed service profile or variable prices.

claim: Matched final stock leaves exactly zero flat-tariff cost opportunity for the archived feasible fill on 252 original cases and 12 retrospective splices.
assumptions: Exact W05 dyadic coefficients; actual fit to minimum forced cumulative discharge; feasible matching alternative includes baseline.
falsifier: Feasible lower discharge on the same path or failure of an exact primal constraint.

claim: Primary service threshold excluded 56 of 72 equal-weight paths and met by 14 feasible issued-schedule witnesses; two lack an admissible baseline.
assumptions: One quantized storage unit, 12 or 24 hour deterministic paths, original four-hour window comparator.
falsifier: If a full-model witness reaches the target in an excluded eligible case, retract that exclusion.

claim: At the original hourly service profile, the cost target is excluded on 49/72 and met on 21; two baselines are ineligible.
assumptions: Illustrative tariff, wear and closing contracts.
falsifier: A violating alternative must preserve the identical hourly service and terminal contract.

claim: Power and energy rule out 37 service targets and 25 cost targets before LP. Exact LP adds three service and ten cost exclusions. Objective lattice adds zero.
assumptions: Cumulative strictly-below stopping rule.
falsifier: Re-evaluate each rational ceiling and compare with the prespecified exact threshold.

claim: All eight constructed optima match, including two equality controls; there are no false exclusions. Three deliberate invalidations were rejected.
assumptions: Only these controls and encoded contracts.
falsifier: Feasible target with a reported exclusion or failure to reject known mutations.

claim: Native MILP actions attained the exact optimum on 140 eligible case-objectives and eight controls; native reported bounds coincided within 1e-6 native units.
assumptions: Exactness depends on discrete-state replay; solver bound is numerical.
falsifier: Any admissible command improves on independent backward optimum or solver stats drift beyond tolerance.

claim: Staged timed calls consumed more aggregate wall time than direct exact DP on both objectives and less than direct MILP.
assumptions: Three warmed rotates on one host, 216 calls per objective-arm including ineligible cells.
falsifier: Recompute or rerun with clean time accounting and disclose machine dependence.

claim: All 1296 warmed decision calls returned within 0.5 s; each cold worker launch and public warm-up exceeded 0.5 s.
assumptions: Includes ineligible cases. Dedicated warm services incur setup cost separately.
falsifier: A recorded over-deadline eligible or ineligible dispatcher receipt invalidates the warm claim.

claim: Flat ample and scarce families exclude both targets on all 12 cases per family; all 12 time-of-use cost cases have feasible material improvements.
assumptions: Designed synthetic family weights; no field frequency.
falsifier: Reconstruct alternative profiles or find case-level mismatch.

claim: Post-primary eight-hour baseline raises exclusions to 67 and 61 of 72 for service and cost, respectively, with original targets and cost service profile fixed.
assumptions: Exploratory reuse; no fresh confirmation.
falsifier: Any changed hourly cost-service obligation, worse accepted primary objective, invalid action or moving threshold.

claim: The LP bound is strictly below the exact discrete optimum on 32/70 service and 45/70 cost cells.
assumptions: Full LP relaxes mode and action integrality in a finite-box integer plant.
falsifier: Recompute LP multipliers and compare with independent discrete optimum.

claim: Recomputed 252 complete exact W05 fill witnesses and 504 rational diagnostic economic gaps.
assumptions: Frozen ZIP pair verified; independent fill recurrence on supplied inputs.
falsifier: Any unequal action or rational gap fraction.

claim: Exactly zero matched-service/stock cost opportunity in all 252 W05 cases and 12 coupled paths.
assumptions: W05 tariff, battery model, each fill attains the discharge envelope.
falsifier: Positive excess cumulative discharge invalidates this saturation argument.

claim: At original W05 scale single horizon inventory ceiling at most $1,175.54 subject to discharge saturation; four 30-day splices each bound at $39.19/day (rounded up).
assumptions: Nonnegative stock/cycling coefficients, matched hourly service and state ceiling 180, final floor 95 MWh.
falsifier: Variable pricing, mismatched service or unverified additional cycling.

claim: Against price rule, mean fresh perfect-foresight headroom $100.91/$83.18 per site-day at 7/30 days.
assumptions: Finite declared action lattice, equal terminal 9 MWh and complete hourly service.
falsifier: Any cheaper-than-bound feasible path or invalid recomputed potential.

claim: Checked 8,260,320 finite-plant Bellman edges over 128 offline objectives and reconstructed attaining paths.
assumptions: Full declared finite state-action graph with known exogenous trajectory for the lower bound.
falsifier: Inconsistent value recursion, lower-bound direction, or unmatched attaining path.

claim: Fresh flat-tariff optimal stock-only value $4.21/$0.67 per day, versus $28.43/$26.63 under artificial daily resets.
assumptions: Fresh 12 MWh site, exact hourly service, $50 credit; horizon-average units.
falsifier: A change of fixed terminal or queue/calendar conditions produces a different contrast.

claim: On continuous variable-price paths optimal stock-only effect averaged $25.39/$7.35 per day.
assumptions: Matched fill terminal versus floor, $50 closing credit and same service/wear/reserve model.
falsifier: End-credit or reserve-capacity definition changes the estimand.

claim: H12 fitted terminal mark gains $55.32/$40.45 per day against the price rule and $46.96/$48.40 against H12 zero tail.
assumptions: Confirmed eight synthetic seed groups and paired 7/30-day paths; common forecasts, duty and stock.
falsifier: Any changed service, terminal, undisclosed forecast, or evaluation leakage.

claim: All four sign tests on improvement exceeding $15/day have Holm-adjusted p=0.015625.
assumptions: One-sided independent seed-level sign tests under synthetic-generator null; paired horizons, familywise Holm.
falsifier: Extrapolation beyond the generator or use of per-hour pseudo-replicates.

claim: The fitted mark loses to a stronger 3-scenario H12 comparator on mean ($2.03/$2.35 per day); no case beats it by $15.
assumptions: Supplement locked after the main comparisons, same issues, terminal mark and physical contract.
falsifier: Candidate beats the stronger stochastic comparator on future preregistered paths.

claim: Applied all jobs and protected service with verified headroom and final 9 MWh for each matched controller. Pending booked work crossed all 280 internal midnights.
assumptions: Outages suspend contracted reserve during zero power; booked jobs and firm feeder.
falsifier: Queue, action, protected dispatch, reserve or end-stock failure.

claim: Optional-work valuation lowers modeled offline costs while losing 980/1253 and 4278/5558 low-priority jobs.
assumptions: Separate contract allows shedding, $18 penalty per unserved low job.
falsifier: Matching service would be necessary for a service-preserving economic claim.

claim: 83 primary guard fallbacks occurred; zero measured one-second misses out of 42624 primary/diagnostic decisions.
assumptions: Single machine; includes the diagnostic free-fill trajectory and per-step validation.
falsifier: Timing/host dependence or unchecked unsafe applied fallback.

claim: All 24 explicit time-expanded HiGHS LP objectives matched exact rolling H12 and admitted applied actions.
assumptions: First 24 epochs selected by separate supplemental protocol, first 7-day path, no terminal guard binding.
falsifier: Numerical LP objective disagreement or first action outside optimal set.

claim: No field/net deployment benefit or calibrated multi-market reliability claim.
assumptions: Synthetic prices, reserve availability only, illustrative wear and job values; costs to deploy unknown.
falsifier: Independent field trace, activated reserves, calibrated costs and matched security contract would change the scope.

claim: All 16 repeated holdouts admit nominal complete service, mandatory one-hour call deliverability and no-further-call terminal recovery under the stronger contract.
assumptions: Internal dispatch blocks, signed pre-call ramp, hourly demand, public clear end window, full availability envelope before that.
falsifier: An infeasible mandatory call endpoint, unrecoverable endpoint or incorrect graph edge.

claim: Each policy passed all 1655 up and 1629 down calls; continuation supported 4781 stacked optional calls.
assumptions: One independent hour per perturbation; mandatory and optional upward demand jointly tested.
falsifier: These standby checks cannot establish performance under repeated or actually dispatched reserve.

claim: On hardened standby, continuation beats price by $72.25/$61.12 per day but gains only +$0.14/−$2.78 against stochastic at 7/30 days; 0/16 meet $15 versus stochastic.
assumptions: Matched no-call private costs and all three controllers use same public data, included paths and stronger contract.
falsifier: Independent fresh trajectories or an activated cost/risk objective could change this result.

claim: All 12 full AC candidates admit certified nearby exact feasible points in the six benchmark snapshots
assumptions: Static AC polar contract and correct Arb enclosure and decoded data
falsifier: Failed contraction or original voltage/angle/thermal/generator limit

claim: Three of six primary AC cases exclude a one-percent cost reduction versus the selected local witness
assumptions: Exact source coefficients and valid global lifted lower bound
falsifier: Feasible witness with a lower cost at or beyond the target

claim: All three stressed cases remained open after the primary cut budget
assumptions: Relative target fixed before solving
falsifier: Replayed primary bounds close a stressed gap

claim: Certified clique cuts on reused stressed cases close the 39-bus case and narrow the 30- and 89-bus intervals
assumptions: Original incumbents and same physical contracts
falsifier: Invalid voltage lift or insufficient outward allowance for coefficient error

claim: Three of four full-UC cases exclude a one-percent target against a rationally feasible incumbent
assumptions: Published PGLib-UC model and exact-decimal RHS with full commitment freedoms
falsifier: Independent original model rejects the schedule or lower certificate

claim: Two native MILP runs reach their solver time limit; one still has a checked exclusion
assumptions: Single thread and 30-second solver limit
falsifier: Different stored termination or upper witness

claim: The 31-node rational disjunction still leaves the February 24-hour case open
assumptions: Exhaustive child coverage and original horizon
falsifier: Checked final floor excludes target

claim: Independent arithmetic checks exposed rounded RHS and non-replayable solver ordering in intermediate UC attempts
assumptions: Only reissued canonical data admitted
falsifier: Fresh original-model or cross-process replay fails

claim: Across 160 fixed schedules, at $150/kWh the continuation policy loses to three-scenario by $7.32/$3.90 per site-day under primary and $3.07/$2.54 under one-call (7/30 days). One-call seven-day sign flips near $59.16/kWh.
assumptions: Whole-path rainflow, NMC illustrative depth curve, no calibration or reoptimization, matched original services separately within each contract.
falsifier: Different cell/price/activation/dispatch assumptions can reverse the fixed-path ranking; published former cost optima are invalid under direct transfer.
